title: SWIM Completes 8th Consecutive Week on Billboard Hot 100; ARIRANG Sets All-Time K-pop Billboard 200 Top-5 Record
detail: Billboard's May 16-dated charts (released May 11, 2026) confirm that 'SWIM' — BTS's lead single from ARIRANG — completes its eighth consecutive week on the Billboard Hot 100, cementing the all-time record for the longest Hot 100 run by a K-pop track in chart history. 'SWIM' debuted at No. 1 in late March 2026 and has sustained chart presence through sustained global streaming momentum. On the Billboard Global 200, 'SWIM' remains near the top 3, extending the record for the longest consecutive K-pop Top-3 run on that chart. ARIRANG, the group's album, simultaneously holds in the Billboard 200 Top 5 for an eighth consecutive week — the longest any K-pop album has ever maintained a Billboard 200 Top-5 presence in chart history. The album's sustained performance is driven by continued streaming activity, physical sales momentum from the ARIRANG World Tour, and strong radio support for 'SWIM.' The milestone comes as BTS is on a scheduled rest and travel day in Mexico City following the completion of three sold-out nights at Estadio GNP Seguros (May 7, 9, 10). The Las Vegas leg of the ARIRANG World Tour — six nights at Allegiant Stadium starting May 23 — is expected to deliver another significant chart impact. 49,000 equivalent album units were registered in the week ending May 7, sustaining ARIRANG's chart position. Thirteen of the album's tracks remain charting concurrently on the Billboard Global 200 — a record for any K-pop release.

title: HYBE Launches New Label ABD (A Bold Dream) — New Girl Group Subsidiary Planned for H2 2026
detail: HYBE Entertainment announces the launch of a new multi-label subsidiary named ABD — standing for 'A Bold Dream' — in a move that signals the company's continued expansion beyond BTS-era mainstays. The new label is headed by Noh Ji-won (formerly of Pledis Entertainment) with Han Sung-soo overseeing creative production; Han is known for producing Seventeen, TWS, and IZ*ONE. ABD's first act is expected to be a girl group planned for the second half of 2026. The announcement coincides with HYBE's release of its Q1 2026 earnings, which showed nearly $480M in revenue — driven heavily by the ARIRANG World Tour's North and Latin American legs. HYBE's multi-label structure has been a core pillar of its growth since the 2019 restructuring: it encompasses Big Hit Music (BTS), BELIFT LAB (ENHYPEN), PLEDIS (Seventeen), KOZ Entertainment (Zico), ADOR (NewJeans, though currently in litigation), and now ABD. For BTS and the broader HYBE ecosystem, ABD represents the company's ongoing bet on building a broader K-pop portfolio while BTS's ARIRANG era generates record revenues in 2026. Korea Herald and Billboard Pro both covered the launch as a significant label expansion in the K-pop industry.

media.caption: HYBE launches new label ABD — A Bold Dream — with girl group planned for H2 2026
